name: furnacesPlus
author: Saniee
title: Furnaces Plus
description:
Adds new Advanced furnaces from the old ones! from the first 3 its just normal furnaces from the game that are modified to be electric and do less pollution. After t3 there is no pollution and furnaces go extremly fast.

Stats (crafting speed / modules / pollution per min): MK1 2 / 0 / 1, MK2 4 / 0 / 2, MK3 4 / 4 / 0.5, MK4 12 / 4 / 0.2 (rocket fuel), MK5 24 / 6 / 0 (nuclear fuel). Vanilla furnaces are 1, 2 and 2.

Recipes:
MK1: 25 stone, 20 electronic circuit, 20 iron stick
MK2: 45 steel plate, 35 advanced circuit, 30 stone brick, 25 iron stick
MK3: 120 steel plate, 45 processing unit, 60 stone brick, 20 electric engine unit
MK4: 240 steel plate, 90 processing unit, 120 stone brick, 40 electric engine unit, 50 low density structure
MK5: 500 steel plate, 150 processing unit, 200 stone brick, 100 electric engine unit, 10 low density structure, 20 uranium-238, 1 uranium-235
